desc_en: A bold expression of contemporary aesthetics. This wide-leg jumpsuit features an abstract print inspired by urban art. Warm tones and vibrant accents intertwine fluidly within a sophisticated silhouette. Wide straps and a camisole neckline define a modern structure. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una expresion audaz de la estetica contemporanea. Este mono de pierna ancha presenta un estampado abstracto inspirado en el arte urbano. Tonos calidos y acentos vibrantes se entrelazan con fluidez en una silueta sofisticada. Los tirantes anchos y el escote camisola definen una estructura moderna. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
